info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Fooddelivery Deliveries Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Deliveries API allows users to cancel existing food delivery orders efficiently. This endpoint is primarily used by food delivery services that need to manage delivery statuses and orders effectively. After a user initiates a cancellation request, the system processes it in real-time to update the order status accordingly. Typical consumers include delivery personnel and administrative staff involved in order management and customer service. Seamless integration ensures that all stakeholders are informed about the cancellation status promptly.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specified delivery. Ensure that the delivery is eligible for cancellation and follow the required cancellation policies.

requestBody.description: Request body to cancel a delivery. This body must include the necessary details to identify the delivery to be canceled.

DeleteFooddeliveryDeliveriesCancelReques.description: Request body for canceling a delivery operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation result.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation request.

DeleteFooddeliveryDeliveriesCancelRespon.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on deliveries cancellation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the request was made automatically by a system.

Audit.description: Audit information for tracking the creation and automation of requests.
